## Load Antigen-Selected Databases (S19 for now)

We will expand shortly to combine `{S19, S20, S21}` for re-cleaning (as they will have many duplicates and many of the same poorly-formed clusters).

### Load individual clonal database

```{r, warning = F, eval = T, echo = F}
db <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/clean_results/19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')

db$f <- rep("19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", each = nrow(db))

# Trim CDR3s
db$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(db$junction_aa)

# Translate
db$VHH <- translate_DNA(db$sequence_alignment)

# Trim
db$VHH <- substr(db$VHH, 11, nchar(db$VHH))

# Keep productive only
nrow(db)
db <- unproductive(db)
nrow(db)
```

### Iterate over top 5 clonal families

```{r}
#db <- db[order(db$duplicate_count, decreasing = T),]

db <- db[db$clone_id %in% names(table(db$clone_id)[order(table(db$clone_id), decreasing = T)])[1:5],]
```

```{r}
## Write to fasta for clustering in MMseqs2
write_fasta <- function(df, seq_col, id_col,file_out){
  seqinr::write.fasta(sequences = as.list(df[[seq_col]]), names = df[[id_col]], file.out = file_out)
}
```

## Deduplicate before clustering

```{r}
root_dir <- "~/Downloads/"

for (nm in unique(db$clone_id)){
  tmp_frame <- db[db$clone_id == nm,]
  write_fasta(tmp_frame, "VHH", "VHH", paste(root_dir,"S19-Deduplicated-Clone-",nm,"-22Mar24.fasta", sep = ''))
}

```
